title: Mainichi, Asahi Shimbun and Yahoo Japan report that referee Kawakami regained consciousness after being hit in the head by a bat
summary: The game official, seriously injured during a match, expressed his desire to return to umpiring once he recovers.

title: Asahi Shimbun and Mainichi report on the same acquittal verdict in the case of the murder of the president of Gyoza no Ohsho
summary: A court acquitted a member of a criminal organization due to insufficient evidence to prove his guilt.

title: Asahi Shimbun and Mainichi report on the shooting at an elementary school in Oregon that left four dead
summary: A 16-year-old minor attacked with a firearm at a school, killing four people and the attacker was shot dead.

title: Mainichi and Asahi Shimbun cover the arrest of a Japanese journalist in Russia and the consular conflict
summary: Russian authorities detained a reporter from Hokkaido Shimbun, while Tokyo seeks to secure a consular meeting.

title: Mainichi and Asahi Shimbun report on the certification of the first Living National Treasures in the field of living culture
summary: Three masters of Kyoto cuisine, sake brewing, and flower arrangement were recognized for the first time in this new field.

title: Asahi Shimbun and Yahoo Japan report the death of a high school student in Kure due to bullying and train collision
summary: An external commission recognized that the student was suffering from bullying before being hit by a train and dying.

title: Asahi Shimbun and assets.wor.jp cover the recognition of Osaka Castle and Nara Hotel as Important Cultural Properties
summary: Eight properties, including Showa era buildings, were approved for designation by the Council for Cultural Affairs.
